note: Real Autotrader page pasted by Amogh (2026-11-10); dealer phone removed. Answers read from the page by hand before running VinVerdict. A franchise dealer's 'Used 2025 Land Rover Range Rover SE' listed with '1 mi': a used car with almost no miles is usually a dealer-registered demo or loaner, or a placeholder the dealer never filled in, so the buyer should see the odometer (and a 1-mile figure would skew a price comparison). Traps: 'Land Rover' is a two-word make and 'Range Rover' a two-word model (the Range Rover Sport, Velar and Evoque are different cars); '308 mi away' before '1 mi'; 'Documentation Fee + $595' in the price box; '$2,000 below the previous asking price', '$1,624/mo.', '$23,000' down, '$92,694 amount financed'; 'Santorini Black Exterior / Ebony … Leather Seats'; no title or accident history on the page.
